Catacomb junction — four bone-lined tunnels radiating from a central chamber, niche upon niche of the dead rising to the vault, a single stone pillar at the center, the darkness total at each mouth.

Great organ hall — standing beneath the pipes looking upward, the instrument consuming the entire west wall from floor to vaulted ceiling, cold air pressing down from heights the eye cannot fully reach.

Undercroft of chains — low groin-vaulted ceiling hung with massive iron chains descending into the black water below, each chain vanishing beneath the surface, the space vast and low and cold and echoing.
Cathedral nave stretching into cold obscurity — ribbed vaults soaring overhead, columns marching in endless recession toward a distant altar lost in shadow, stone breathing silence.
Crypt of kings beneath the castle, low heavy vaults pressing down over rows of stone sarcophagi, carved effigies sleeping in the dark, frost lacing the mortar between ancient blocks.
Catacomb ossuary tunneling into blackness — walls stacked floor to vault with skulls and long bones, arched niches holding the arranged dead, the corridor vanishing into absolute dark.
Cursed grand library ascending through cold air — towering shelves receding upward into vaulted gloom, iron spiral stairs coiling into shadow, chained tomes lining shelves no living hand has touched.
Throne hall vast and empty, colonnades marching the length of the chamber into darkness, a distant throne cold and enormous at the vanishing point, the floor a mirror of pale stone.
